guide.name: OASIS West Bengal Portal
guide.fullTitle: OASIS Scholarship Portal 2026: Login, Status & App Guide
guide.seoDesc: Complete guide to the OASIS West Bengal portal (oasis.wb.gov.in) for SC, ST, and OBC students. Learn how to check scholarship status, login, and apply.
guide.description: The OASIS portal is the dedicated scholarship platform administered by the Backward Classes Welfare Department and Tribal Development Department of West Bengal. It is exclusively for processing Pre-Matric and Post-Matric scholarships for SC, ST, and OBC students.

loginSteps.title: Complete Mandatory NSP OTR (For ST Students)
loginSteps.desc: ST students must first log in to the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or use the NSP OTR mobile app to generate their One-Time Registration (OTR) via face authentication before applying on OASIS.

loginSteps.title: Register or Login on OASIS
loginSteps.desc: Visit oasis.wb.gov.in. New users click 'Student's registration' while existing users click 'Registered Student's Login'.

loginSteps.title: Select District
loginSteps.desc: Choose the district where your institution is located. If studying outside West Bengal, select your permanent address district.

loginSteps.title: Fill Details & Perform KYC
loginSteps.desc: Enter your Aadhaar number, Khadyasathi number, and Caste Certificate details. Complete Aadhaar OTP validation or Biometric KYC as prompted.

statusSteps.title: Step 1: Open the Track Application Page
statusSteps.desc: Go to the oasis.wb.gov.in homepage and click on the 'Track an application' button.

statusSteps.title: Step 2: Select Your District
statusSteps.desc: Choose the district where your institution is located (or permanent district if studying outside the state).

statusSteps.title: Step 3: Check Verification & Payment
statusSteps.desc: Submit your Application Serial No/User ID and Academic Session to view your block/institute verification status and Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB) disbursement progress.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.note: Aadhaar-based biometric authentication or OTP KYC is mandatory. Must be seeded with your bank account.

documents.name: Caste Certificate
documents.note: OBC certificates issued before 01.08.2025 must be revalidated on castcertificatewb.gov.in before applying.

documents.name: Khadyasathi Card
documents.note: Students must enter their Khadyasathi number in the designated place on the application.

documents.name: Income & DOB Proof
documents.note: Income certificate and proof of Date of Birth must be submitted to the Block/Sub-Division/DWO Kolkata office for verification.

documents.name: Bank Passbook
documents.note: Scholarship amount will be credited to your own Aadhaar seeded bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer.

faqs.q: How can I check my OASIS scholarship payment status?
faqs.a: Click 'Track an application' on oasis.wb.gov.in and enter your User ID. Since all payments are processed through the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB) system, ensure your bank account is DBT-enabled and Aadhaar-seeded via NPCI.

faqs.q: What is the last date to apply for OASIS scholarships in 2026?
faqs.a: The general deadline for SC, ST, and OBC pre-matric and post-matric scholarship schemes on the OASIS portal for the 2026-27 cycle is October 31, 2026.

faqs.q: Are Aikyashree and SVMCM scholarships available on the OASIS portal?
faqs.a: No, the OASIS portal is strictly for SC, ST, and OBC students. Minority students must apply on the Aikyashree portal, and students seeking merit-based aid should use the SVMCM portal.

faqs.q: Why is my OBC caste certificate not being accepted on OASIS?
faqs.a: If your OBC caste certificate was issued before August 1, 2025 (01.08.2025), you must revalidate it first by visiting castcertificatewb.gov.in before applying on the OASIS portal.

faqs.q: Do I need an NSP OTR to apply on the OASIS portal?
faqs.a: Yes, if you are an ST student. The Ministry of Tribal Affairs (MoTA) requires ST students applying for Pre-Matric or Post-Matric scholarships to generate an OTR on the NSP Portal before applying on oasis.wb.gov.in.

faqs.q: Is Biometric KYC mandatory for OASIS applications?
faqs.a: Yes, as per Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment guidelines, biometric KYC is mandatory for Pre-Matric and Post-Matric SC students.
